# Error Handling in Compilation

The CompileError exception handling could lead to incomplete error management and reports during compile failures. If errors occur during the compile process without proper logging or feedback to the user, it may hinder debugging and maintaining correct states.

- `knowledge_compiler/compiler/run.py`
